messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content: Here are some fun true or false questions that work for introducing a new teacher to 生徒たち in your classroom. They work great as an icebreaker activity on the first day. Write each 質問 on a card and have students guess if true or false, then the teacher shares the 答え one by one. Here are some ideas to get started: The teacher's favorite color is actually 趣味. The teacher has a pet lizard named Steve. The teacher once ran a full marathon for マラソン. The teacher's middle name is a type of pasta. The teacher's dream trip destination is 旅行. The teacher's go-to karaoke song is a heavy metal classic. The teacher was a varsity athlete 選手 in high school. The teacher's biggest fear is public speaking. The teacher has one incredible hidden 特技, a backflip. The teacher has met a famous person at least once. Students will love this 活動 because it makes them feel like they are getting to know the teacher in a personal 方法. Encourage them to ask follow-up questions after each reveal. It really creates a genuine sense of 最初 excitement.
